judge.voice: I pressed the big button and it asked me about Roblox and YouTube, so that was fun. The cat answer made me laugh. The choosing tasks were easy, and the listening one was okay. The last two were harder, but I could still write something. It said A2, and I think that is right. I liked that it told me how to say things, like "in Roblox there is only chat". But the TV showing "take long time" as my words felt a bit like it was catching me out. The long text about B1 being close was too much to read. I would use it again after school. I want it to give me points or a game and to tell me more about what I did well. I would tell my cousin.

#10 task 5 is 'not yet' and the note names the gap: 'Verb forms held it back'. Praise and gap both appear, and the note matches the verdict.
#10 focus is 'Practise verb endings: "take long time" becomes "takes a long time"', which matches her actual slips. Past tense was not elicited in these tasks.
#5 'play Roblox' and #6 'What are you doing on Saturday?' are different prompts.
